name: Annual Copenhagen Film Festival 2019
description:
The Annual Copenhagen Film Festival is an international independent film festival held annually in Copenhagen, Denmark. 

It aspires to promote, recognize and support independent filmmakers throughout the world by hosting a variety of awards in order to provide the best opportunities for filmmakers to get recognized in a very competitive industry. 

ACFF is run in association with Close:Up, a collection of international film festivals supporting indie filmmaking. By establishing a working network among filmmakers, producers and marketing professionals, we share one common goal: to forge productive and lasting relationships between independent filmmakers and audiences.

The event will be totally free of charge and is open to every cinephile who loves independent film as much as we do.

name: Workshop: Marketing and Promotion for Filmmakers
description:
As part of our 3rd edition of Annual Copenhagen Film Festival, we are excited to be partnering up with Rossscammm Films and Marketing in offering an exclusive 2-hour workshop, on the topic of Marketing and Promotion for Filmmakers. In our extensive experiences with filmmakers, we've been told over and and over again that one of the most daunting obstacles for young, independent creators is navigating the festival circuit. Our mission is to encourage and support up-and-coming filmmakers, so we are very thrilled to have Rosa Camero lead a tailored workshop on this very issue. 

This is a workshop that will help you improve your networking skills and get to know the right people when attending film festivals. Rosa will share a formula that she and her team personally use in Rossscammm Films and Marketing every time they go to a film festival, which has helped them  close deals and meet the right people.

What to expect?
> You will learn what to do before the film festivals, because preparing is part of this adventure.
> You will know what to do and how to network during the festival.
> You will learn what to do after the film festival and follow up those hot leads.

Rosa has over a decade of experience working with film marketing and distribution in Mexico, Spain and Denmark. This workshop will not only be an excellent opportunity to learn more about how to maximize your time on the festival circuit, but also a priceless occasion to meet and network with other filmmakers from abroad who are being celebrated at Annual Copenhagen Film Festival 2019.

So don't miss out - we have a very limited number of seats available for this workshop, guaranteed to help you put your best foot forward next time you're attending a film festival.
